name: Spore pod icon
description: UI slot icon for the spore pod. Composes `ss.proj.mine` itself via `use` — the cache the icon promises is the cache the ground shows — replacing the old hand-drawn i_mine (grey disc, red core). Rim is `$soul` — the pod is four browns and one cold fuse light, and the fuse is the only part of it that is not every other weapon's colour.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_mine_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
